title: One Pot Creamy Sausage Pasta

ingredients.item: 8 oz penne (about half a 16 oz box)
freshly grated Parmesan, plus more to serve

steps: Brown. Heat oil in a large deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook sausage and onion 5–7 minutes, breaking up the sausage, until browned. Drain if needed.
Garlic. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.

Simmer. Add broth, cream, marinara, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper and the uncooked penne. Bring to a gentle boil, then cover on medium-low for 12–15 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until tender.
Spinach. Stir in the spinach for 1–2 minutes until wilted.
Finish. Off the heat, stir in the Parmesan and butter until creamy. Rest 3–5 minutes; serve with extra Parmesan, parsley or basil, and garlic bread.
notes: * Step 7 of the caption adds butter, but the ingredient list gives no amount.
